column7: \func deriv {A : Ring} (a : FSeries A) : FSeries A
\lemma deriv-leibniz {A : Ring} {a b : FSeries A} : deriv (a * b) = deriv a * b + a * deriv b
\lemma deriv-pow-conv-suc {A : CRing} (b : FSeries A) (n : Nat) : deriv (pow b (suc n)) = natCoef (suc n) *c (pow b n * deriv b)
\lemma deriv-compose {A : CRing} (a b : FSeries A) (b_0 : b 0 = A.zro) (k : Nat) : deriv (fcompose a b) k = (fcompose (deriv a) b * deriv b) k
